content: MK's footnote on the Yazdī collection as it appears in MS Sinā 316: a postscript or colophon, possibly to the whole collection, attributes it to Qivām al-Dīn Yazdī as author and compiler and gives a completion date of 5 Rabīʿ I 849/11 June 1445, well beyond Qivām al-Dīn's death; that copy was made on 7 Shaʿbān 878/28 December 1473.
